task: DAEO-p8tv (W2-172)
status: PACKAGES
work_completed: I stopped run 1 (tests) at the interface check (DEC-1052). The ticket has no `## Interface` section, while its siblings DAEO-61vm and DAEO-k1e2 each have one. No test designer was started. I wrote PKG-W2-172-IFACE-1, which holds a complete 12-section Interface block the CTO can paste into the ticket. It is built from the launch script's code (`indep_launch.py` at `1d0d8da0d`: its flags, exit codes 10–22, the counts line and the `AUDITS.log` form), W2-170's and W2-171's Interfaces, `rebuild/integration.py` (the store link, `<link>.lock` and the ready half's HEAD as its build) and MEMORY-AUDIT-1 §3.3 and §4.
files_changed: none committed. Scratch only (gitignored): `.gov-runtime/scratch/lead/packages/PKG-W2-172-IFACE-1.md` and `.gov-runtime/scratch/lead/CHECKPOINT.md`
evidence: `gov links: 0 new since 1d0d8da0d, 1705 standing (...; commits 0)`. Interface sections exist in the sibling tickets (`grep '^## Interface'` finds DAEO-61vm:90 and DAEO-k1e2:82) but not in DAEO-p8tv. `git status --short` is empty.
tests: none run (no tests exist yet; the designer was not started under DEC-1052)
discoveries: (1) The KPIs leave several things unstated. The driver must learn the round-2 decision, the USED boundary and the verdict without opening a folder under the sets root (F1's file-access spy). The proposal does this through child processes only: the checker's launch counts (`out.revise + out.rejected`), the measure's exit code for USED, and a new read-only `figures` subcommand run as a child. (2) S1's order lists no step for `judge` or `classes`, yet the auditor needs `misses.jsonl` from `judge`. The proposal puts `judge` before the auditor and `classes` after it. (3) `~/gov-os-runs` holds the substring `runs/`, which F1's grep would match, so the runs folder goes to the children only through `GOV_INDEP_RUNS_DIR`, never on a command line. (4) The crontab's class differs between documents: the ticket says (O), while MEMORY-AUDIT-1 §4 says (b) in `class-rules.yaml`. The wrapper holds no crontab either way, so this ticket is not affected. (5) DEC-1052 governs the stop and is not in `sources:`.
risks: O1, the 24-hour age read as the commit's committer time, refuses a week's audit when nothing merged into w2/integrate that day. O2: the gate check named in the proposal (`gate_check.py --full-run` plus the store's `<link>.lock`) is the lead's reading of "the gate's own check".
lessons: For a ticket lead, the interface check costs less when the ticket's `reads:` lists the sibling Interfaces as well.
proposed_decisions: PKG-W2-172-IFACE-1 option (a). The CTO pastes the block into DAEO-p8tv as `## Interface` (delegated P2, as PKG-W2-171-IFACE-1 (a)) and answers O1 to O4, each of which already has a default in the block.
unresolved: O1 the 24-hour age (the commit's time or the build's time); O2 the gate command; O3 refuse `RN-NOBASE` when no baseline exists; O4 the pinned interpreter's path. The probe record folder `docs/probes/DAEO-p8tv/` is not in `allowed_paths`, and FULL needs it before the review.
recommended_next_action: The CTO accepts PKG-W2-172-IFACE-1 (a) in one line, pastes the Interface into DAEO-p8tv, adds `docs/probes/DAEO-p8tv/**` to `allowed_paths` and starts a tests run. That run begins at the tests worktree step; the checkpoint's NEXT line says so.
